findings: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from the Skill Shop. The user quickly fires a Ki wave; if it hits, the attack ends, while a miss causes the user to teleport behind the opponent and perform a kick. Current dedicated evidence reports approximately 10% damage for either outcome.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
